INSERT INTO kb_answer_card_source (revision_id, document_id, version_id, applicability_version, effective_from, until_kind, effective_until) VALUES (#{revisionId}, #{documentId}, #{versionId}, #{applicabilityVersion}, #{effectiveFrom}, #{untilKind}, #{effectiveUntil})

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kb_answer_card_review (id, card_id, branch_id, revision_id, round_no, state, review_version, submitted_by, submitted_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{cardId}, #{branchId}, #{revisionId}, #{roundNo}, #{state}, #{reviewVersion}, #{submittedBy}, #{submittedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_answer_card_review SET state = #{state}, review_version = review_version + 1, decided_by = #{actor}, decided_at = #{at}, reason = #{reason} WHERE id = #{id} AND state = 'IN_REVIEW' AND review_version = #{expected}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kb_answer_card_stewardship (card_id, responsible_user_id, cycle_months, first_assigned_on, last_confirmed_on, last_confirmed_revision_id, stewardship_version) VALUES (#{cardId}, #{responsibleUserId}, #{cycleMonths}, #{firstAssignedOn}, #{lastConfirmedOn}, #{lastConfirmedRevisionId}, #{stewardshipVersion})
